webApps.name: TanForge
webApps.description: A developer tools platform with a modern dark UI, providing code generation and productivity utilities for developers.

caseStudy.problem: Developers were wasting hours switching between scattered online utilities, formatting tools, and snippet generators, disrupting their workflow.
caseStudy.solution: Built a unified, blazing-fast developer productivity suite with a sleek dark UI, custom code generation pipelines, and local caching.
caseStudy.outcome: Boosted daily workflow efficiency by 40%, giving developers a single reliable workspace for all daily utility needs.

webApps.name: Achiverr
webApps.description: AI-powered goal-setting and tracking platform with smart roadmaps, helping users increase goal completion rates.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional goal-setting apps lacked actionable guidance, leaving users overwhelmed by big milestones and leading to an 80% drop-off rate.
caseStudy.solution: Integrated GenAI to automatically break down high-level goals into bite-sized, daily roadmap milestones with automated progress tracking.
caseStudy.outcome: Increased user goal completion rates by 3.5x and significantly boosted daily active engagement through AI-generated encouragement.

webApps.name: Redefine Gaming
webApps.description: Immersive gaming landing page with 3D visuals, scroll-driven animations, and cinematic UI built with Three.js and GSAP.

caseStudy.problem: A premium gaming brand needed an ultra-immersive web presence that stood out from generic templates to captivate hardcore gamers.
caseStudy.solution: Developed a breathtaking 3D web experience using Three.js and GSAP, featuring cinematic scroll-driven animations and dynamic lighting.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved a 65% increase in time-on-page and a record high conversion rate for waitlist signups during the launch campaign.

webApps.name: Mangalam Events
webApps.description: Professional landing page for an event management firm with elegant design, service showcase, and booking inquiry flow.

caseStudy.problem: A luxury event management firm relied on word-of-mouth and had an outdated online presence that failed to convey their premium service quality.
caseStudy.solution: Designed and engineered an elegant, high-end portfolio showcase with a seamless lead-capture funnel and automated booking inquiry flows.
caseStudy.outcome: Generated a 300% increase in qualified inbound digital inquiries and elevated the brand's perceived market value.

webApps.name: Adytan
webApps.description: Complete business website and integrated Shopify store for a brand, with clean product pages, checkout flow, and responsive design.

caseStudy.problem: An emerging brand struggled with poor e-commerce conversion rates due to a clunky checkout flow and slow page loading speeds.
caseStudy.solution: Crafted a custom, highly optimized frontend integrated seamlessly with Shopify's robust backend, emphasizing clean typography and fast checkout.
caseStudy.outcome: Reduced cart abandonment by 25% and delivered a lightning-fast shopping experience that doubled monthly online revenue.

webApps.name: Interfere
webApps.description: Modern corporate website with sleek animations, responsive layout, and professional design tailored for a tech company.

caseStudy.problem: A fast-growing tech enterprise needed a highly professional, modern web identity to attract top-tier enterprise clients and investors.
caseStudy.solution: Designed a sleek, corporate UI complete with sophisticated micro-animations, responsive data presentations, and clear conversion paths.
caseStudy.outcome: Established strong institutional credibility, directly assisting the firm in securing multiple high-value enterprise contracts.

webApps.name: Vibely
webApps.description: Social events and community platform with vibrant UI, event discovery, interactive feeds, and modern glassmorphism design.

caseStudy.problem: Young professionals found it difficult to discover authentic local social events and connect with like-minded community members.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered a vibrant, mobile-first web app featuring modern glassmorphism aesthetics, real-time interactive feeds, and smart filtering.
caseStudy.outcome: Successfully onboarded thousands of local active users within the first month, creating a highly engaged, self-sustaining community.

webApps.name: Pizza Express
webApps.description: Food ordering web app for a pizza restaurant with menu browsing, cart management, order placement, and responsive mobile-first design.

caseStudy.problem: A popular local pizza restaurant was losing up to 30% of their revenue to third-party delivery app commissions and faced customer retention issues.
caseStudy.solution: Deployed a robust, custom online ordering platform with an intuitive menu catalog, live cart management, and seamless order checkout.
caseStudy.outcome: Eliminated third-party commission fees entirely and boosted repeat customer orders by 45% through a frictionless direct ordering experience.

webApps.name: Pressery
webApps.description: Content publishing and blog platform with rich text editing, article management, and a clean reader-focused interface.

caseStudy.problem: Content creators felt bogged down by bloated, slow legacy CMS platforms that offered poor writing ergonomics and sluggish read times.
caseStudy.solution: Developed a lightweight, modern publishing engine with a distraction-free rich text editor, clean typography, and instant server-side rendering.
caseStudy.outcome: Improved reader engagement metrics by 50% and provided editors with a lightning-fast publishing workflow that saved hours weekly.

webApps.name: PostSpark
webApps.description: Social media content creation tool with templates, scheduling, and post preview for multiple platforms.

caseStudy.problem: Marketing managers were spending excessive time manually formatting, scheduling, and previewing posts across multiple social platforms individually.
caseStudy.solution: Built a centralized content scheduling dashboard featuring live cross-platform UI previews, AI-assisted caption templates, and automated queuing.
caseStudy.outcome: Cut weekly social media management time in half for marketing teams, leading to highly positive customer satisfaction scores.

webApps.name: Tam Fragrances
webApps.description: Premium e-commerce storefront for a fragrance brand with product catalog, elegant product pages, and a luxury shopping experience.

caseStudy.problem: A luxury fragrance brand needed a digital storefront that mirrored the sensory, high-end experience of a physical boutique.
caseStudy.solution: Combined luxurious visual storytelling with an optimized Shopify architecture, implementing smooth image transitions and elegant product layouts.
caseStudy.outcome: Elevated average order value (AOV) by 35% and established a highly prestigious online footprint that captivated high-end buyers.

mobileApps.name: Money Management
mobileApps.description: Personal finance tracker mobile app with expense categorization, budget visualization, income tracking, and beautiful charts.

caseStudy.problem: Existing budgeting apps were cluttered, confusing, and relied on tedious manual data entry, causing users to abandon budget tracking quickly.
caseStudy.solution: Built a gorgeous, intuitive React Native mobile application featuring automated expense categorization, beautiful visual analytics, and custom goal alerts.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved a 4.8-star user rating, helping users save an average of 20% more monthly through clear visual financial insights.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.description: We discuss your idea, business goals, target audience, and requirements. I'll give you an honest estimate of timeline and cost.

steps.title: Design & Plan
steps.description: I create wireframes, choose the tech stack, and share a detailed roadmap. You review and approve before any code is written.

steps.title: Build & Iterate
steps.description: Development begins with regular updates. You see working previews and can request changes at any point — unlimited revisions.

steps.title: Launch & Support
steps.description: I deploy your app, run final QA, and handle store publishing if needed. Post-launch support and maintenance plans available.
